chunks: He (Al-Hassan ibn Muhammad) from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ali ibn Atiyyah from Hisham ibn Ahmar who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to a companion, 'Go to your honor,' meaning the market.
ai.seo_question: What did the Imam mean when he called the market 'your honor'?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) encourages a companion to go to the market, referring to it as 'izz' (honor or dignity), thereby elevating the status of trade as a legitimate and noble means of livelihood. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on self-sufficiency and the moral virtue of engaging in commerce, provided it is free from usury and deceit, as outlined in the chapter's context.
